raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MXFP4 W4A16 experts declare BF16 activations, so MoRI dispatches raw BF16 and
AITER quantizes to group-32 MXFP8 on arrival. A token routed to `k` distinct
ranks is therefore quantized `k` times — expected ~4.4 of 8 ranks at topk=6 for
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash — and the dispatch carries 2 bytes/element instead of
1 + 1/32.

Quantizing in `prepare()` moves that to once per token on the rank that owns it,
and roughly halves the dispatch payload.

AITER already consumes the result: with a pre-quantized FP8 operand and E8M0
scales, its stage-1 path sorts the scales (`mxfp4_moe_sort_fwd`) instead of
running its own quant. This mirrors the MXFP4 W4A4 dispatch added in #59596,
which takes the same pre-quantized route for a4w4.

## Summary of changes

**`all2all_utils.py`** — adds `mori_use_mxfp8_dispatch()` and wires a third
dispatch mode into `maybe_make_prepare_finalize()`. MoRI infers the payload
dtype from the input tensor and transports `scale_dim` scales of
`scale_type_size` bytes per token, so the new branch sets
`scale_dim = hidden_dim / 32` and a 1-byte scale element. E8M0 exponents are
bytes, not the fp32 the per-token/per-tensor FP8 paths use.

**`prepare_finalize/mori.py`** — adds the `use_mxfp8_dispatch` flag and the
corresponding quant in `prepare()`, via `get_hip_quant(QuantType.per_1x32)` with
`scale_type=dtypes.fp8_e8m0`, matching the FP4 branch directly above it. The
mutual-exclusion assert becomes `sum(...) <= 1` now that there are three modes.

**Gating is deliberately narrow.** A pre-quantized operand is only safe when
AITER would have produced MXFP8 itself: a BF16-activation kernel would cast the
FP8 payload back to BF16 and never apply the scales, silently losing the
scaling. `mori_use_mxfp8_dispatch()` therefore asks AITER directly via
`resolve_activation_dtype()`, which is documented for exactly this case ("lets a
caller that produces the activations itself -- an all-to-all dispatch, a fused
epilogue -- emit that dtype directly") and returns `None` rather than guessing
when the answer would have depended on a token count that does not exist yet.
It also fails closed on `ImportError` and on a hidden dim that is not a multiple
of 32.

## Results

8x MI355X (gfx950), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DP8/EP8 with `mori_high_throughput`,
speculative decoding off. 8192 in / 1024 out, 256 prompts at concurrency 64,
against a stock nightly (`0.32.0rc1.dev190+g3f1bcfd82`) with **only this change
applied** — this PR was measured on its own, with no AITER-side patches, so the
numbers are attributable to the dispatch change alone.

Engagement was confirmed rather than assumed: `resolve_activation_dtype(M=None)`
returns `torch.float8_e4m3fn` under the `AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0` that vLLM
pins for this model, and the dispatch kernel switches from
`EpDispatchIntraNodeKernel_bf16` to `EpDispatchIntraNodeKernel_fp8_ocp`.

### Performance

| Metric | Baseline | With patch | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| Output token throughput (tok/s) | 1103.58 | 1309.33 | **+18.6%** |
| Total token throughput (tok/s) | 9932.18 | 11783.95 | **+18.6%** |
| Median TPOT (ms) | 54.16 | 46.83 | **-13.5%** |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 54.68 | 46.69 | **-14.6%** |
| Median ITL (ms) | 51.40 | 44.29 | -13.8% |
| Mean TTFT (ms) | 3392.14 | 2248.40 | -33.7% |
| Benchmark duration (s) | 237.54 | 200.21 | -15.7% |

### Accuracy

gsm8k, 5-shot, all 1319 questions.

| Arm | strict-match | stderr | Delta | flexible-extract |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline | 0.9196 | 0.0075 | — | 0.9196 |
| With patch | 0.9280 | 0.0071 | +0.0084 | 0.9287 |

Within ~1 sigma of baseline. The same mxfp8 quantization is applied either way;
this only changes which rank performs it and how many times.

### Reproduction

Server:

```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_SPARSE_MLA=True
export VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1
export VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1

vllm serve /model/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend mori_high_throughput \
  --moe-backend aiter \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --max-cudagraph-capture-size 1024 \
  --block-size 128 \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --language-model-only \
  --no-swa-bounded-replay \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log \
  --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}'
```

Benchmark:

```bash
vllm bench serve \
  --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --tokenizer /model/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 8192 \
  --random-output-len 1024 \
  --ignore-eos \
  --num-prompts 256 \
  --max-concurrency 64 \
  --temperature 0 \
  --seed 0 \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el \
  --metric-percentiles 50,90,99
```

Accuracy:

```bash
lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 \
  --model_args base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/completions,model=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,tokenizer_backend=None,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,timeout=3600
```

nodes.body: Hi @heachary  Thanks for the PR! Due to the relative smaller size of dsv4.1 flash, DEP8 is not a realistic config when deploying for production, can you also test the perf with DEP2 and DEP4?

files.patch:
@@ -179,6 +179,46 @@ def maybe_roundup_layer_hidden_size(
     return hidden_size
 
 
+# AITER's per_1x32 MXFP8 activation quant groups 32 elements per E8M0 exponent.
+MXFP8_GROUP_SIZE = 32
+
+
+def mori_use_mxfp8_dispatch(
+    moe: FusedMoEConfig, quant_config: FusedMoEQuantConfig
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether MoRI should carry MXFP8 activations instead of raw BF16.
+
+    Only safe when AITER would have quantized the activations to MXFP8 itself
+    anyway: it consumes a pre-quantized FP8 operand plus E8M0 scales by sorting
+    the scales rather than re-quantizing, but a BF16-activation kernel would
+    dequantize the FP8 payload without ever applying the scales.
+    """
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm() or not quant_config.use_mxfp4_w4a16:
+        return False
+    if moe.hidden_dim % MXFP8_GROUP_SIZE != 0:
+        return False
+
+    try:
+        from aiter import ActivationType, QuantType, dtypes
+        from aiter.fused_moe import resolve_activation_dtype
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl.moe_common import GateMode
+    except ImportError:
+        return False
+
+    # M is unknown this early; resolve_activation_dtype returns None rather
+    # than guessing when the answer would have depended on the token count.
+    return (
+        resolve_activation_dtype(
+            QuantType.per_1x32,
+            dtypes.fp4x2,
+            activation=ActivationType.Silu,
+            gate_mode=GateMode.INTERLEAVE,
+            M=None,
+        )
+        == dtypes.fp8
+    )
+
+
 def maybe_make_prepare_finalize(
     moe: FusedMoEConfig,
     quant_config: FusedMoEQuantConfig | None,
@@ -332,14 +372,27 @@ def maybe_make_prepare_finalize(
         # MXFP4 activations are dispatched as packed FP4 with their e8m0
         # block scales, which the experts consume without re-quantizing.
         use_fp4_dispatch = quant_config.use_mxfp4_w4a4
+        # MXFP4 experts declare BF16 activations, but AITER quantizes them to
+        # group-32 MXFP8 before stage 1. Doing that in prepare() instead means
+        # a token is quantized once by the rank that owns it rather than once
+        # per rank it was replicated to, and halves the dispatch payload.
+        use_mxfp8_dispatch = not use_fp4_dispatch and mori_use_mxfp8_dispatch(
+            moe, quant_config
+        )
         # Note: We may want to use FP8 dispatch just to reduce
         # data movement.
-        use_fp8_dispatch = not use_fp4_dispatch and (
+        use_fp8_dispatch = not (use_fp4_dispatch or use_mxfp8_dispatch) and (
             quant_config.is_per_act_token
             or quant_config.is_block_quantized
             or quant_config.is_per_tensor
         )
-        if use_fp4_dispatch:
+        if use_mxfp8_dispatch:
+            # One e8m0 scale per 32-element block, one byte each, not the fp32
+            # the per-token/per-tensor FP8 paths below assume.
+            quant_dtype = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+            scale_dim = moe.hidden_dim // MXFP8_GROUP_SIZE
+            scale_type_size = torch.float8_e8m0fnu.itemsize
+        elif use_fp4_dispatch:
             # One e8m0 scale per 32-element block. token_hidden_size stays
             # the unpacked hidden size: mori sizes its token buffers by the
             # BF16 input type, which also covers the BF16 combine.
@@ -383,6 +436,7 @@ def maybe_make_prepare_finalize(
             num_dispatchers=all2all_manager.world_size,
             use_fp8_dispatch=use_fp8_dispatch,
             use_fp4_dispatch=use_fp4_dispatch,
+            use_mxfp8_dispatch=use_mxfp8_dispatch,
         )
 
     elif moe.use_fi_nvl_two_sided_kernels:

@@ -22,14 +22,16 @@ def __init__(
         num_dispatchers: int,
         use_fp8_dispatch: bool = False,
         use_fp4_dispatch: bool = False,
+        use_mxfp8_dispatch: bool = False,
     ):
         super().__init__()
-        assert not (use_fp8_dispatch and use_fp4_dispatch)
+        assert sum((use_fp8_dispatch, use_fp4_dispatch, use_mxfp8_dispatch)) <= 1
         self.mori_op = mori_op
         self.num_dispatchers_ = num_dispatchers
         self.max_tokens_per_rank = max_tokens_per_rank
         self.use_fp8_dispatch = use_fp8_dispatch
         self.use_fp4_dispatch = use_fp4_dispatch
+        self.use_mxfp8_dispatch = use_mxfp8_dispatch
         self._dispatch_topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None
 
     @property
@@ -103,6 +105,19 @@ def prepare(
             # when it receives pre-quantized FP4 input.
             quant_func = get_hip_quant(QuantType.per_1x32)
             a1, scale = quant_func(a1, shuffle=False)
+        elif self.use_mxfp8_dispatch and not defer_input_quant:
+            from aiter import QuantType, dtypes, get_hip_quant
+
+            # MXFP8 [M, K] with e8m0 scales [M, K // 32]. As with FP4 above the
+            # scales stay unshuffled; AITER sorts them itself rather than
+            # re-quantizing when it receives a pre-quantized FP8 operand.
+            quant_func = get_hip_quant(QuantType.per_1x32)
+            a1, scale = quant_func(
+                a1,
+                quant_dtype=current_platform.fp8_dtype(),
+                scale_type=dtypes.fp8_e8m0,
+                shuffle=False,
+            )
 
         # mori's combine() reduces over this rank's own [num_tokens, topk]
         # routing. The modular kernel rebinds topk_ids to the dispatched ids
